text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: La/Div.Sec./3/3/5/15/2. Ref. No.: Min. of Agriculture, Live Stock, Lands, Irrigation-13/99/FR/91. I Here give notice that the Government intends to acquire the following land that is necessary for a public purpose under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, amended by the Land Acquisition (amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964. Acquiring of land for Knuckles conservation is denoted as a public purpose in this effort. Description of the land to be acquired: Details of the plot of land in total extent of 20.2335 Hectares that shown in Zone No. 02, sheet 01, in Surveyor General’s approved C.M. No. 310272 dated 31.12.2024 situated in Atanwala Village of the No. E386 Atanwala Grama Niladhari Division, in Laggala Divisional Secretary’s Division in Matale District of Central Province are as follows: 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Thelgamuwatta; Land Use: Forest; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: by Mr. N.B.

Wickramasinghe who resides at No.44/3, Owilla, Thenna; Extent: 11.8224 Hectares. 02. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Thelgamuwatta; Land Use: Forest; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mr. N.B. Wickramasinghe who resides at No.44/3, Owilla, Thenna; Extent: 8.4111 Hectares. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents before me at 9.00 a.m. on 07.04.2025, at the Laggala Divisional Secretariat. And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the day of 26.03.2025, the nature of their interests in the Land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
gfg SWARNA PERERA, Divisional Secretary, Laggala Pallegama.
At Divisional Secretary’s Office - Laggala, Pallegama On 17th February 2025. EOG 02-0159
